name: Budni po-pionerski
source:
This is far from Semyon's first cycle in Sovyonok. A lot has changed in him since the first shift. His outlook on life has become simpler, his personality has changed for the better, and he is no longer chasing after answers. Semyon has grown accustomed to the laid-back camp life. It suits him perfectly, and he wouldn't mind if everything stayed exactly like this. And all around him are the same camp residents he has become so very used to. They have become his best friends, at the very least. He has seen it all during the past shifts...

And now, another shift, or rather, the very height of it. Will it present something new and unforgettable to our heroes? Will it become special?

The typical routine is constantly getting tangled up with dubious prospects. Olga Dmitrievna has suddenly cooked up something more complicated than the usual grounds cleanup, Alisa and Ulyana are once again languishing from idleness and boredom while seeking out trouble, the cybernetics club is planning another excursion outside the camp, and Semyon's new friend always has his own agenda in mind. A tangle of various escapades once again unites the well-known pioneer campers. What will it all lead to?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=884276044]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这距离谢苗在《索维诺克》的第一个周期还很遥远。自从第一次轮班以来，他发生了很多变化。他的人生观变得简单了，性格也变好了，不再追求答案。谢苗已经习惯了悠闲的营地生活。这非常适合他，如果一切都保持这样，他不会介意。他周围都是他已经非常习惯的营地居民。至少，他们已经成为他最好的朋友。在过去的轮班中，他已经看到了这一切……

现在，又一个转变，或者更确切地说，是它的高度。它会给我们的英雄们带来一些新的、难忘的东西吗？会变得特别吗？

典型的惯例就是不断地与可疑的前景纠缠在一起。奥尔加·德米特里耶夫娜（Olga Dmitrievna）突然搞出了比平时清理场地更复杂的事情，艾丽莎（Alisa）和乌里安娜（Ulyana）再次因无所事事和无聊而苦苦寻找麻烦，控制论俱乐部正在计划另一次营地外的旅行，而谢苗（Semyon）的新朋友总是有自己的议程。各种各样的冒险活动再次将著名的先锋露营者团结在一起。这一切会导致什么？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=884276044]Steam[/url]]
